course.title: Speakio B1
course.description: Günlük, sosyal ve profesyonel durumlarda daha akıcı ve bağlantılı İngilizce.

units.title: Life Experiences
units.goal: Geçmiş deneyimlerden ve hayat tecrübelerinden bahsetmek.
sentences: She has already finished the course.
dialogue: Have you ever worked abroad?
Yes, I worked in Germany in 2022.
listening: I have recently started a new hobby.
Have you ever learned another language?
She has already made a decision.
speaking: Tell me about something you have achieved.

exercises.q: Hiç başka bir ülkede çalıştın mı?
exercises.answer: Have you ever worked in another country?
I have already finished the course.

units.title: Work & Communication
units.goal: İş ortamında fikirleri açık ve nazik biçimde ifade etmek.
sentences: We need to finish this task today.
You should speak to your manager.
dialogue: Could we change the schedule?
Sure, I will check with the team.
listening: You should send the report today.
Could we have a short meeting?
speaking: Give advice to a new colleague.

exercises.answer: Could we change the meeting?
You should send the report today.

units.title: Travel Problems
units.goal: Seyahat sırasında sorunları anlatmak ve çözüm istemek.
sentences: I was waiting when they called.
dialogue: My luggage is missing.
I am sorry. We will check the system.
listening: I was waiting at the gate.
My passport is in my bag.
speaking: Describe what happened at an airport.

exercises.answer: My flight was delayed.
I missed my connection.

units.title: Health & Advice
units.goal: Sağlıkla ilgili belirtileri ve önerileri ifade etmek.
sentences: I need to make an appointment.
dialogue: What is the problem?
I have had a headache since morning.

exercises.answer: I need to make an appointment.
You should get some rest.

units.title: Media & News
sentences: The report says prices are rising.
She told me the news was true.
dialogue: Where did you hear that?
I saw it in a local newspaper.
speaking: Explain how you choose reliable news.

options: The report says prices are rising.

exercises.answer: I read an interesting article.
The story was published online.

units.title: Relationships
sentences: She is someone who always helps me.
O, bana her zaman yardım eden biridir.
I trust people who are honest.
Respect is important in every relationship.
dialogue: Why do you trust him?
Because he is reliable and honest.
listening: She is a person who listens carefully.
speaking: Explain what makes a relationship healthy.

exercises.answer: I trust people who are honest.
Respect is important in every relationship.

units.title: Environment
sentences: If we recycle, we will produce less waste.
Geri dönüştürürsek daha az atık üretiriz.
Clean energy can protect the environment.
Air pollution is a serious problem.
dialogue: How can we help the environment?
We can save energy and recycle.

options: If we recycle, we will help.

exercises.answer: We should reduce waste.
If we recycle, we will help.

units.title: Education
units.goal: Eğitim, öğrenme yöntemleri ve hedefler hakkında konuşmak.
sentences: I decided to take an English course.
It is difficult to concentrate when you are tired.
My goal is to speak confidently.
dialogue: How do you practice English?
I try to speak every day.
listening: My goal is to improve my writing.
Try to concentrate for ten minutes.

exercises.answer: I try to speak every day.
My goal is to speak confidently.

units.title: Technology
units.goal: Teknoloji kullanımı, avantajlar ve riskler hakkında fikir belirtmek.
sentences: We need to protect our privacy.
This device is easier to use.
dialogue: Is the app secure?
Yes, but you should update it regularly.
listening: This service is easier to use.

exercises.answer: We should protect our privacy.
Technology can save us time.

units.title: Opinions & Decisions
sentences: In my opinion, this is better.
Although it is expensive, it is useful.
I prefer this option because it is simpler.
Bu seçeneği tercih ediyorum çünkü daha basit.
dialogue: Which option do you prefer?
I prefer the second one because it is cheaper.
listening: In my opinion, we should wait.
speaking: Give your opinion about online learning.

exercises.answer: In my opinion, this is better.
I prefer this option because it is simpler.

units.title: Plans & Possibilities
sentences: I am going to apply for the job.
If I had more time, I would study more.
Daha fazla zamanım olsaydı daha çok çalışırdım.
I will call you when I arrive.
dialogue: What are you going to do next year?
I might move to another city.
listening: I am going to start tomorrow.
If I had the chance, I would travel.
I will let you know soon.
speaking: Talk about your plans for next year.
Describe an opportunity you would like.

options: If I had time, I would travel.
If I have time, I will travel.
If I had time, I travel.
If I would have time, travel.

exercises.answer: We might travel next month.
I will call you when I arrive.

units.title: B1 Review & Storytelling
units.goal: B1 yapılarını bir arada kullanarak akıcı bir hikâye anlatmak.
sentences: While I was walking, I saw an old friend.
Although it was late, we continued talking.
Geç olmasına rağmen konuşmaya devam ettik.
Neyse ki her şey iyi gitti.
dialogue: What happened next?
Suddenly, the lights went out.
listening: Although we were tired, we continued.
Finally, we found the right place.
speaking: Tell a story using at least three connectors.

options: While I was walking, I saw him.
While I walking, I saw him.
While I was walk, I saw him.
While was I walking, saw him.

exercises.q: Neyse ki her şey iyi gitti.
exercises.answer: Fortunately, everything went well.
Although we were tired, we continued.
